prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production walking SPRITE SHEET for THIS EXACT EXISTING UI MASCOT. Reference is the identity master and MUST remain the character, not a style inspiration. Preserve its exact flat 2D cel-shaded illustration: cream-white round head and same small feather tuft, identical big simple blue eyes and black eyebrow shapes, exact orange beak/smiling openmouth, original head-to-body proportions, original golden-yellow hoodie and simple smiley badge, same blue shorts, brown cross-body strap and satchel, same orange-yellow bird feet. NO realistic fur/feathers, no 3D gloss, no painterly reinterpretation, no different face, no extra tuft, no new eyelashes, no new outfit. Keep the head/face essentially locked like the source across ALL frames; ONLY legs, arms, body weight and satchel sway animate.
Create exactly EIGHT sequential walk-cycle frames arranged in a precisely regular 4 COLUMN x 2 ROW GRID (frames1-4toprow,5-8bottomrow), transparent background, ideally2048x1536 total. Each equal cell has one full-body original mascot in the SAME slight right-facing three-quarter direction, consistent pixel height and common baseline, generous empty gutter so neighboring limbs NEVER overlap cells, no cut-off toes/head/bag. Walking in place, not running or marching: left front heel-contact, down/weight, right foot passing, right foot lift, right front heel-contact, down/weight, left foot passing, left foot lift; feet alternate and arms counter-swing, very subtle headbob. Clean natural seamless loop fromframe8to1. Character center stays fixed acrosscells. GENUINELY transparent surroundings. No ground/shadows, no grid lines, no text, no frame numbers, no UI. This must visibly be the SAME original game UI Swifty, now walking.
runtime: Original UI bitmap at rest; CSS eight-frame strips during motion. Front/back/left/right chosen per path segment; rear view for stair climbing. Direction timers share scene/map cleanup.

angles.left: Mirrored right-facing sprite; only sprite child is mirrored, parent motion stays unchanged.

angle_generation.brief: Preserve original flat 2D UI character exactly. Transparent 4x4 atlas, front 8-frame walk in first two rows, rear 8-frame walk in last two rows, same hoodie/shorts/bag, no face visible from rear. Normalize at actual alpha row seams to retain feet.

hand_cleanup.brief: Remove redundant left-rear dangling arm/hand from frame3 and frames5-8; retain near foreground arm and far arm behind satchel. Exactly two arms per frame, preserve original UI identity. Visually reviewed all eight corrected frames.
